This directory vendors 3d-force-graph (minified) for offline use by the REDNESS
live 3D graph. It is redistributed under the MIT License, reproduced below. The
minified bundle also includes three.js (MIT) and d3 modules (ISC / BSD-3-Clause);
their notices are covered by the same permissive terms.

Project: 3d-force-graph  -  https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph
